items.title: Ice Warrior
items.description: The Ice Warriors are a fictional extraterrestrial race of reptilian humanoids in the British science fiction television series Doctor Who. Natives of Mars, the Ice Warriors wear bio-mechanical armour to protect themselves from attack and temperature fluctuations. items.description: Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. items.title: Tom Jackson (American football, born 1951)
items.description: Thomas Louie Jackson, also referred to as "TJ" or "Tommy", was an American football player and sports broadcaster and analyst. He played his entire National Football League (NFL) career as a linebacker for the Denver Broncos from 1973 to 1986. He then worked as an NFL analyst for ESPN from 1987 until his retirement in 2016.
